name: Once, From Behind
description: Tomorrow is tithe-day at Moreva, the eel-landing on the Delta where you trap with Sauve Mor. The Tallymen's collector sleeps tonight against his strongbox, and the tithe-book in it says Moreva owes forty baskets of eels it never caught. Sauve means to have that book before the collector wakes, and nobody is to know it was Moreva.
notes: The rogue's tutorial (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.4, 3.4a), begun by core:opening/rogue; reworked for triage 44 (PROGRESS.md, 'The Rogue's first quest makes sense, and its stealth can be done') and made plainer for triage 51-52: one goal (the collector's tithe-book gone before the count, and nobody the wiser), and each step is a part of it, in the order a thief would do it: (1) the box: crouch, pick it, take the book (core:item/tithe_book, in the strongbox's loot core:loot/tithe_strongbox), and the sleeper's pocket if you like; (2) the traps: carry the book down to Sauve's punt at his traps past the night-watch, who must not see a stranger coming away from the box; (3) the sack, one blow from behind to learn it; (4) the bravo, whose round ends at the empty box; (5) the report: the page, Tally, the courier. The traps: Tella Oul (the Reed Council's night-watch, a lantern on her: the stage's `unseen`, NightWatch) stands at the head of the way down to the South Channel looking down it; the lane on the way's east side is sheltered from her by five `cover` props (QuestCover); the straight way down passes six metres in front of her lantern. Seen, the try fails (triage 78): the quest goes to the `seen` detour (NightWatch, the `unseen`'s `fail_stage`), whose one objective is to speak to Sauve again, back where the night began (his landing spot, out of her sight); speaking to him (`traps_again`) sends the quest back to the_traps, and the attempt begins clean: the flag down, her meter from nothing, the book still in your bag (Sauve hands it back if it is not). Sauve waits at his traps through that stage (she knows him) and is `with_you_when` the quest is active, so the HUD's eye reads the watch and not him. The strongbox is a QuestSpots prop (a locked WorldContainer the Tallymen own, `prop:strongbox`) opened on the lockpick screen (`pick_lock`); the collector (core:npc/tithe_collector) sleeps beside it through the three night lessons, and lifting from his pocket is the optional `pickpocket` act. The sack is a Pell of kind sack (`prop:sack`), which never sees anybody, so a crouched blow from behind is a sneak attack. The bravo walks the landing's round at first grey (QuestFoes, `round`), in fog. Tally, Sauve's own mare, is handed over after the first lesson (the_strongbox's on_complete, tied on the south-east boards: `tally_tether`), not to be ridden on the boards that night; getting up on her is the report's (`mount`), for the road after the courier. Every change of stage is said out loud by Sauve as it happens, and each journal entry opens on why. test_rogue_plays plays it with the body and the keys.

stages.journal:
Sauve Mor is waiting to tell you what tonight is for, and why you are here.

He is standing on the open boards south of the landing's gardens, a few paces from you, in the fog. Go and speak to him, quietly.

objectives.text: Speak to Sauve Mor on the boards {key:interact}

stages.journal:
Tomorrow is tithe-day.

Brannock Tole, the Tallymen's collector, sleeps tonight against his strongbox, and the tithe-book in it says Moreva owes forty baskets of eels more than it ever caught. At the count the Charter believes the book, not the eels. Sauve means to have the book before he wakes.

Go to the collector's strongbox on the landing's south-east boards, crouched. Pick its lock, and take the tithe-book out of it. Don't wake him.

How: crouched, you make less noise and are harder to see. Set the lock's pin as the needle crosses the band. A lock picked is a crime, and a crime seen is a bounty, so do it where nobody is watching. And if you have the hands for it, his pocket too: a sleeping man's pocket is a lock with no pin at all, if you come at it low.

objectives.text: Go quietly: crouch {key:sneak}. He sleeps light

say: Low. Good. The box is on the south-east boards, with him asleep against it. Pick it, and bring me the book at my traps.

objectives.text: Pick the collector's strongbox: {key:interact}, then set the pin as the needle crosses

say: Snapped them all? Here's three of mine. Slower. Feel for it.

objectives.text: Take the tithe-book out of the strongbox
Crouched {key:sneak}, lift something from the sleeping collector's pocket {key:interact}

say: He never woke. That's the whole lesson. The key's only a key.

Got it? Good. — And Tally's yours: my mare, tied on the south-east boards. By noon a stranger who was on the boards on tithe-eve will want to be somewhere else. Not tonight, mind; hooves on boards wake the dead. — Now bring me the book, down at my traps. Past Tella, and she doesn't see you.

stages.journal:
You have the book. Sauve is waiting at his eel-traps on the South Channel's edge with his punt, which takes it where no Tallyman looks.

Between you and him is the night-watch.

Carry the book down to Sauve at his traps, south of the landing, without the watch seeing you.

Tella Oul keeps the Reed Council's watch at the head of the way down, with a lantern. She knows Sauve. She does not know you, and a stranger coming away from the collector's box on tithe-eve is somebody she has to name at the count; then the Tallymen turn Moreva over looking for the book.

How: go down the lane on the east side of the way, crouched, keeping the stacked traps, the crates and the old boat between you and her lantern. The corner of your eye says what she has of you: Unseen, Noticed, Seen. Noticed: stop behind something and let her forget you. Seen, the try is spoilt: go back to Sauve where the night began, and he will start you again.

said: You! On the boards! Who's that, low there?
Seen. Leave it. Come back up to me, where we started; we'll go again when she's done looking.

objectives.text: Take the book down to Sauve at his traps, south of the landing, without Tella seeing you

stages.journal:
Tella saw you on the boards. She has called out, and she is looking hard at where you were; that try is spoilt.

Sauve has come back up to where the night began, behind her, to start you again before she makes a name of it.

Go back to Sauve where you started, and speak to him.

How: she is still looking down the way, so keep out of her lantern going back. When Sauve sends you again, the watch begins again from nothing.

objectives.text: Seen: go back to Sauve where the night began, and speak to him again

stages.journal:
At first grey the collector's bravo walks his round, and it ends at the empty box; Sauve means him never to reach it, and your hand learns the blow on a sack first.

The book is in Sauve's punt. But at first grey the collector's bravo gets up and walks his round of the landing, and his round ends at the empty box. Last tithe-day he broke Hobb's hand for a short basket; finding the book gone, he will go through every house on Moreva. Sauve means him never to reach the box: one blow from behind, before he knows you are there. First, your hand learns it on a sack.

Go to the sack of eels hung from a crossbar at the landing's south-west edge. Come round behind it, crouched, and strike it once.

How: a dagger from behind, into something that never saw you, does six times what it does to something watching.

objectives.text: Crouched, come round behind the eel-sack and strike once {key:attack_light}

say: Once. From behind. Then gone. Twice is a fight, and you don't fight.
First grey. There he goes, on his round. Before he gets to the box.

stages.journal:
First grey, and the fog is up off the channels. The bravo is walking his round of the landing, and it ends at the empty box.

Put down the collector's bravo before he reaches the strongbox. He walks with his hand on his hilt: along the south boards past the box, up the east side, across between the houses, down the west side past the sack, and round again.

How: follow him crouched. When he turns, keep a house or a stack between you; when his back is to you, close and strike once. One blow from behind, before he knows you are there, ends it or nearly. If he turns on you, break his line of sight and come again. Face to face he will cut you to pieces.

objectives.round_notes: along the south boards past the strongbox, up the east side, across the landing's middle between the houses, and down the west side past the sack, clear of the gardens' fences the whole way (test_start_rogue walks it)
objectives.text: Put down the collector's bravo before he reaches the box
Crouched, from behind, before he knows you are there {key:attack_light}

say: In the reeds. Good. Come here; there's something in the book.

stages.journal:
The bravo is in the reeds, and Sauve has been through the book in his punt. He has found something in it.

Go to Sauve on the landing.

The collector woke to an open box, no book and no bravo. He is sitting on the boards with a very good reason to say nothing to anybody.

objectives.text: Go to Sauve on the landing

say: Get up on Tally and go after him. Don't catch him. Just see.

name: The Unsaid Page
description: Folded into the back of the tithe-book was a Tallymen's ledger page: a village's debt, with UNSAY written across it. Somebody has paid to have a village's name struck. The courier who carries the other copy is walking south, not to Tollmere, and Sauve wants to know where.
notes: The rogue's tie-in (docs/FIGHTING_STYLE_STARTS.md 3.4, 3.4a): the courier is a lead (Leads, a humanoid dressed as core:npc/tithe_courier) that keeps a field ahead by road, out of the Delta by Nauve's Landing and the Eelweir, round the Mere by Sedgehithe and Stride's Foot, and south by Merrowby (whose green the courier waits on while you turn east to the Hearthstone at Ansel's Hedge Shrine, near halfway: Merrowby has none) to the Stair Head, where he walks past the Warden's fire and down the stair, and the Naming begins at down_the_stair. Tally was given in the tutorial's first stage and the page in its report (triage 52), so the first objective is the ride on her. The road threat is the Dodger's Stone's cutpurses, the Tallymen's own trade, up by day.

stages.journal:
The courier carries the other copy of the unsaid page, and he ought to be on the Tollmere road with it.

Instead he is walking south out of the Delta, grey in the face. Sauve's man in Gullhithe wants your copy; Sauve wants to know who is getting his.

Get up on Tally and ride after the courier, out of the Delta by Nauve's Landing and the Eelweir, to Sedgehithe. Keep him in sight; don't catch him. He keeps a field ahead of you however you come on, and does not look back.

Sauve says there is a Hearthstone at Ansel's Hedge Shrine, past Merrowby: touch it on the way, and if the road kills you, you wake there. Whistle for Tally if you leave her behind.

objectives.text: Get up on Tally {key:interact}, on the south-east boards
Ride after the courier, out of the Delta to Sedgehithe

on_complete.notify: At the Dodger's Stone, west of Stride's Foot, the Tallymen's cutpurses are working the road.

stages.journal:
The courier walked through the cutpurses at the Dodger's Stone, on the road west of Stride's Foot, and they did not see him. They see you.

Get past the two cutpurses at the Dodger's Stone.

objectives.text: Get past the cutpurses at the Dodger's Stone

on_complete.notify: The courier walks on east, into the Vale, towards Merrowby.

stages.journal:
Past the Dodger's Stone the courier walks on into the Vale, and at Merrowby he stops on the green and waits for you, which a courier does not do.

Follow him to Merrowby, then turn east along the Tamwick road to Ansel's Hedge Shrine and put your hand on the Hearthstone in its lee, as Sauve said. He will wait on the green.

Merrowby's bell has been humming in its hole for a week, and nobody will say why.

objectives.text: Put your hand on the Hearthstone at Ansel's Hedge Shrine, east of Merrowby

on_complete.notify: The courier walks on south, by Wynstead and Ashwell.

stages.journal:
The courier walks on south, and you follow him to where the road ends.

He goes by Wynstead and Ashwell to Pilgrim's Ash, and past the Sunken Choir to a Wardens' camp on a cliff's edge, above a stair going down into grey mist.

Follow him there, and speak to the Warden at her fire.

objectives.text: Speak to the Warden at the Stair Head

say: You. Tallyman. Stop. — He's not stopping. Nobody comes back up!
